newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish PM,deputy tight-lipped on censure motion.
newsitem.headline: Turkish PM,deputy tight-lipped on censure motion.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan and Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller were tightlipped on Friday over an opposition censure motion designed to topple their government.
Erbakan simply smiled as he left a meeting with Ciller just hours after the motion was submitted. Ciller, who had earlier scorned the attempt and predicted it would fail, said nothing.
Four of the five opposition parties in parliament submitted a joint censure motion earlier on Friday against Erbakan and his cabinet in a bid to topple the Islamist-conservative alliance.
The motion accuses Erbakan and his ministers of dividing the officially secular country along Moslem-secularist lines.

Opposition and dissident government MPs have been negotiating for some time to try to bring down the government, which has been accused by Turkey's traditional elite, particularly the military, of putting the country's secularist make-up in danger.
